messages:
carmen: quick sanity check - after yesterday's splitter tweak i'm still seeing lots of tiny fragments (1-3 vectors) on mixed-dim workloads. cpu per-token went up.

lee: can you share a minimal repro? model, client shapes, and whether requests include multiple dims in one root?

carmen: repro: 2 tenants, random mix of dims 512/1024/2048, some single-vector calls. test harness: 150 concurrent clients for 4m. splitter logs show lots of low-count fragments.

taylor: we've been conservative to avoid coalescing different dims across shards. but maybe the fragmentation threshold is too aggressive. propose a client-shape hint header so router can take a safe fastpath instead of blind-splitting.

nina: what header? we should avoid expanding API surface too much.

carmen: idea: X-Embed-Profile: dims=1024,vectors=24,avg_tokens=12
If present, router and splitter can try shape-aware packing and choose a shaped queue for that dims. optional, non-binding. servers must treat as hint only.

lee: +1 to a hint. also want server->client suggestion payload when we auto-split. e.g. {"suggest_split":8, "note":"mixed_dims"} so SDKs can adjust before retrying.

taylor: agree. telemetry checklist for console: fragment_count_per_root (p50/p95), small_fragment_rate (<=4 vectors), shaped_hint_adoption_rate, and per-tenant estimated_units.

nina: estimated_units - we need a consistent internal unit to reason about cost/quotas. propose unit = ceil(dims / 256) * vectors. so 1024 dims * 24 vectors => 4 * 24 = 96 units. makes billing understandable across dims.

lee: that formula is neat. finance will squawk if we change invoices. can we ship it as a preview only in console with opt-in? show "preview_units" on usage page, not billable.

carmen: rollout idea: (1) add X-Embed-Profile hint server-side support, (2) wire telemetry, (3) show preview_units in console for 7d for opt-in tenants, (4) canary dims-aware packing to 5% traffic, collect perf + cost delta, then ask finance for billing change.

taylor: ops fallback: if splitter creates >25 fragments for a root, auto-backoff and route remainder to a low-precision embedding model (compatible dims) or return suggestion to client. avoids CPU spikes.

nina: console UX: a small panel per-tenant showing "Small fragment alerts" with auto-split % and recommendation link (enable hint header / bump client batch size). also an opt-in checkbox labeled "Use dims-preview billing (beta)". clicking shows example calc.

carmen: example curl with hint header:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -H "X-Embed-Profile: dims=1024,vectors=24" \\
  -d '{"input":["foo","bar"]}'
```

lee: metric/alert thresholds: small_fragment_rate > 3% triggers paging alert for infra. 413_rate > 1% for 10m triggers tenant-visible warning. shaped_hint_adoption < 20% after 2w -> product follow-up.

taylor: for SDKs: when receiving server suggestion, SDKs should honor suggested split or expose a friendly error to users with recommended split size. we'll add helpers in python/node sdks.

ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: splitter v2.5.0 to eng-platform (canary=5%). Monitor: splitter.fragment_size.p50, splitter.fragment_count.p95, shards.cpu_util.

nina: next actions: carmen write RFC + k6 logs, taylor draft SDK handler, lee mock console preview tile, i'll coordinate with finance for preview permissions. tagging @infra once RFC link is up.

carmen: thanks all, i'll post RFC link and initial k6 artifacts here. low-friction opt-in preview seems safest to collect data before billing changes. :sparkles:
